resources.string: Debug test build for sensory comfort. Reads accessibility labels locally to mute recognized ads and optionally show a dark, still cover in YouTube, Tubi, and Plex. Optional YouTube controls use on-device screenshot text recognition on Android 11 or newer to activate explicit lower-right Skip ad, or Skip/Dismiss paired with Sponsored. Pixels and text are discarded; no uploads or recordings. An explicit developer command can take a diagnostic screenshot and retain only brightness counts. Press Back twice to release protection for one minute. Detection can miss ads and cannot guarantee protection from flashes.
